name: disc
title: The disc: what the launcher throws
orientation: Flat on the bed, the chamfered face down. Print six at a time, 100% infill: a heavier disc flies further than a hollow one.

diameter.rule: The disc's diameter, from the launcher's rules

chamfer.rule: The bed edge, chamfered against first-layer squish, so stacked discs lie flat

dimple.rule: A shallow dimple's diameter in the top face: a thumb finds the top, and it shows which way up the stack goes

smooth.rule: Segments round the disc: the rim rolls along the lid, so it should be round
